notes.zh: Mesh 新增按 ID 配对点云与双/三视窗对比，支持高度、RGB、数值着色和全部视窗图片导出；各工具统一设置入口，手机对比区可横向滑动。原生高斯显示设置移到主工具栏，需安装同版本 APK 生效。
notes.en: Mesh adds ID-paired point clouds, two/three-pane comparison, height/RGB/scalar coloring and multi-pane image export. All tools share settings navigation with horizontally scrollable mobile comparisons. Install the matching APK for the native Gaussian Display toolbar change.
